english.name: Settlement
english.description: Reach a population of 300 citizens.

schinese.name: 聚落
schinese.description: 使城镇人口达到 300 人。

english.name: Village
english.description: Reach a population of 600 citizens.

schinese.name: 村庄
schinese.description: 使城镇人口达到 600 人。

english.name: Town
english.description: Reach a population of 900 citizens.

schinese.name: 城镇
schinese.description: 使城镇人口达到 900 人。

english.name: Educated
english.description: Have a fully educated population with 200 adults for 4 years.

schinese.name: 全民教育
schinese.description: 让一座拥有 200 名成年人的城镇保持全员受教育状态 4 年。

english.name: Uneducated
english.description: Reach a population of 300 citizens without building schools.

schinese.name: 未受教育
schinese.description: 不建造学校，将人口发展到 300 人。

english.name: Jack of all Trades
english.description: Build a town of over 200 people that has someone working in every profession for at least 5 years.

schinese.name: 万事通
schinese.description: 建立一座人口超过 200 人的城镇，并使每种职业连续至少 5 年都有人从事。

english.name: Mountain Men
english.description: Using a harsh climate and a small mountainous map, maintain a population of 50 people for 20 years.

schinese.name: 山民
schinese.description: 在严酷气候的小型山地地图上，将人口维持在 50 人达 20 年。

english.name: Tombstone
english.description: Fill graveyards with at least 400 graves.

schinese.name: 墓碑
schinese.description: 使墓地里至少有 400 座坟墓。

english.name: Blacksmith
english.description: Equip a population of over 200 adults with steel tools for 4 years.

schinese.name: 铁匠
schinese.description: 让超过 200 名成年人连续 4 年使用钢制工具。

english.name: Stylish
english.description: Cloth a population of over 200 with warm coats for 4 years.

schinese.name: 时尚
schinese.description: 让超过 200 名居民连续 4 年穿着保暖大衣。

english.name: Isolationist
english.description: Reach 300 citizens without building a trading post.

schinese.name: 孤立主义者
schinese.description: 不建造贸易站，将人口发展到 300 人。

english.name: One with Nature
english.description: Reach 400 citizens without building crops fields, orchards, or pastures.

schinese.name: 与自然合一
schinese.description: 不建造农田、果园或牧场，将人口发展到 400 人。

english.name: Trader
english.description: Use trading posts to trade 50,000 units of goods in a single town.

schinese.name: 贸易商
schinese.description: 在一座城镇中通过贸易站交易 50,000 单位货物。

english.name: Master Trader
english.description: Use trading posts to trade 100,000 units of goods in a single town.

schinese.name: 贸易大师
schinese.description: 在一座城镇中通过贸易站交易 100,000 单位货物。

english.name: Exports
english.description: Stock the trading post with at least 500 ale, 300 steel tools, and 200 warm coats.

schinese.name: 出口
schinese.description: 在贸易站储备至少 500 桶麦酒、300 件钢制工具和 200 件保暖大衣。

english.name: Firefighter
english.description: Build 20 wells in a single town.

schinese.name: 消防员
schinese.description: 在一座城镇中建造 20 口水井。

english.name: Farmer
english.description: Acquire 3 livestock types, 8 crop seed types, and 8 orchard seed types.

schinese.name: 农夫
schinese.description: 获得 3 种牲畜、8 种农作物种子和 8 种果树种子。

english.name: Livestock
english.description: Build a town that contains 60 cattle, 75 sheep, and 180 chickens.

schinese.name: 牲畜
schinese.description: 建立一座拥有 60 头牛、75 只羊和 180 只鸡的城镇。

english.name: Food Variety
english.description: Grow and harvest 8 different plants and 8 different orchard tree types in a single year.

schinese.name: 食物多样性
schinese.description: 在一年内种植并收获 8 种不同的农作物和 8 种不同的果树。

english.name: Miner
english.description: Maintain 2 mines with 30 workers each for 3 years.

schinese.name: 矿工
schinese.description: 让 2 座矿井各配备 30 名工人并维持 3 年。

english.name: Mason
english.description: Maintain 2 quarries with 30 workers each for 3 years.

schinese.name: 石匠
schinese.description: 让 2 座采石场各配备 30 名工人并维持 3 年。

english.name: Foodie
english.description: In a single year, produce at least 2000 food each from hunters, gatherers, fisherman, pastures, fields, and orchards.

schinese.name: 美食家
schinese.description: 在一年内，让猎人、采集者、渔民、牧场、农田和果园各生产至少 2,000 单位食物。

english.name: Lumberjack
english.description: Produce 50,000 logs within a 100 year period.

schinese.name: 伐木工
schinese.description: 在 100 年内生产 50,000 根原木。

english.name: Stonework
english.description: Produce 10,000 stone within a 100 year period.

schinese.name: 石工
schinese.description: 在 100 年内生产 10,000 单位石材。

english.name: Smelter
english.description: Produce 10,000 iron within a 100 year period.

schinese.name: 冶炼工
schinese.description: 在 100 年内生产 10,000 单位铁。

english.name: Highwaymen
english.description: Build a town with 2000 stone paved road tiles.

schinese.name: 筑路人
schinese.description: 建立一座铺有 2,000 格石板路的城镇。

english.name: Golden Gate
english.description: Build a bridge that is at least 50 units long.

schinese.name: 金门大桥
schinese.description: 建造一座至少长 50 格的桥梁。

english.name: Immigrants
english.description: Allow 200 nomads into a single town.

schinese.name: 移民
schinese.description: 让 200 名游牧民加入同一座城镇。

english.name: Smiles all Around
english.description: Maintain high happiness for 10 years in a town with at least 100 citizens.

schinese.name: 笑容满面
schinese.description: 在一座至少有 100 名居民的城镇中维持高幸福度 10 年。

english.name: Healthy
english.description: Maintain high health for 10 years in a town with at least 100 citizens.

schinese.name: 健康
schinese.description: 在一座至少有 100 名居民的城镇中维持高健康度 10 年。

english.name: Built from Stone
english.description: Build a town with 100 stone houses.

schinese.name: 石砌家园
schinese.description: 建立一座拥有 100 栋石屋的城镇。

english.name: Ready for Anything
english.description: Simultaneously store 2000 fuel, 2000 wood, 500 stone, 500 iron, 200 tools, 200 coats, and 30000 food.

schinese.name: 万事俱备
schinese.description: 同时储存 2,000 单位燃料、2,000 单位木材、500 单位石材、500 单位铁、200 件工具、200 件大衣和 30,000 单位食物。

english.name: Builder
english.description: Build a town that has at least one of every possible structure.

schinese.name: 建造者
schinese.description: 建立一座至少拥有每种可建造建筑各一座的城镇。

english.name: Master Builder
english.description: Build a town with 3 churches, 5 boarding houses, 4 markets, 5 hospitals, 2 trading posts, 6 taverns, and a town hall.

schinese.name: 建筑大师
schinese.description: 建立一座拥有 3 座教堂、5 间寄宿屋、4 个市场、5 家医院、2 个贸易站、6 间酒馆和 1 座市政厅的城镇。

english.name: Established
english.description: Build a town that has a population of 300 after 100 years.

schinese.name: 基业长青
schinese.description: 建立一座历经 100 年且人口达到 300 人的城镇。

english.name: Tenure
english.description: Build a town that has a population of 500 after 200 years.

schinese.name: 世代传承
schinese.description: 建立一座历经 200 年且人口达到 500 人的城镇。
